utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center and could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, yeah I heard — I'm a bit late to the party, but I'm in. Cleo mentioned we're short on tarps, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you're a lifesaver, Dane! And yeah, tarps are a big need—know anyone who might have some we can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, does anyone have the confirmed schedule for the repair drive? I like to plan my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it's this Saturday, but I don't have the exact times yet—maybe Quinn or Uli can fill us in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'm hoping it's still 9 sharp near Elm and Birch like I heard before. Nothing worse than a fuzzy timeline.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I've got the sign-up sheet ready for Saturday—what time works best for you to drop off your repair items?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this repair drive actually confirmed? I still haven't seen any official notice or fliers around.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's definitely on! The Smiths are organizing it—I've been coordinating with everyone, and the fliers should be going up today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Repair drive? Sorry, I've been so scatterbrained lately. Is that this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No, not this weekend—we're planning it for next Saturday. We're still gathering supplies, especially tarps. Do you have any you could spare?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Tarps? I think I might have one in the garage. Let me check later—I keep forgetting where I put things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, I really hope you've thought through the timing—having too few hands during the later shifts could leave us in a real bind.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Don't worry, Pia! I've been telling everyone I see about the repair drive, so we should have plenty of hands throughout the day.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's reassuring, but I'd still like to see a concrete list of who's signed up for each slot—can you share that with me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Hana! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? The Smiths are collecting broken appliances and furniture at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, Tess? The one for the community center or the shed project?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, I think it's both! The Smiths are taking over the community center for it, but I heard they might fix up the shed with some of the bigger pieces too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, did you actually inspect that cracked pipe? I'm trying to figure out if a patch job will hold or if we need to go in on a proper replacement.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the pipe? I think I looked at it... or did I? Let me just check my notes—I'm sure I wrote something down somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, can you just give me a straight answer? Did you see the crack or not? I need to know if we're wasting time on a patch that'll fail in a month.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, I think Hana wants to meet at the shed at 3 to check the repair drive—just a heads up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks Bo, I'll be there at 3. I've got the list of tools we need ready.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you at the shed then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, I've been tracking the repair drive—it's definitely tomorrow, not the weekend. Have you seen the crew setting up near Elm and Birch yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the heads-up, Opal! I haven't seen them yet, but I'll swing by after I round up a few more folks from my block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I'll be there at 8 sharp to help organize—let me know if you need any tools from my shed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Rosa, the repair drive's ready. You need it now or later?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Leo, perfect timing! Let's go with Sunday at the community center — I just confirmed that change with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday works. I'll bring the drive by Saturday evening so it's ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rey, good to see you. We're all set for Sunday—just hoping we get a good turnout to help folks out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm planning to come. Got that pipe under the sink that's been driving me crazy.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Bring it along, I've got a good pipe wrench we can use.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, you heading to the repair drive this Saturday? Heard there's a good turnout planned.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Ira! I'll have my truck loaded with tools—just in case anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Gus! That's exactly the kind of help we need. I'll let the organizers know you're bringing the truck.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I heard you're helping with the repair drive. I've got tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, Gus, I'm definitely spreading the word! It's this Saturday—everyone's bringing what they can, so your tools would be awesome.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just let me know what you need, Vik. I'll make sure my toolbox is ready to go Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got a few old tools I could donate to the repair drive. Where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, are we talking about the community center repair drive or the shed project? I want to make sure I point you to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The community center one, I think. Cleo's collecting supplies over there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Mara, the repair drive's ready. You need it now or later?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, perfect timing, Leo! I could use it now—let's get things moving at the community center. Thanks for checking!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I'll bring it over to the community center in 10 minutes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, I'm helping Leo get the tools ready for Saturday's repair drive. Need any help or just checking in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. Just checking in — Cleo said we're low on tarps, so I'm planning to grab some. You need a hand with the tools first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, that'd be great, Dane. If you could help me sort these wrenches from the screwdrivers, we'll be set before the tarps run.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you joining the repair drive this weekend? I'm trying to get a good group together to tackle a few projects.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, is this repair drive actually confirmed? I haven't seen any official notice or fliers around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's definitely happening! Mara and I have been organizing it, and I've got a few folks from my block ready to help out this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the marker—uh, I think I just pointed it out, didn't tie anything. Sorry, Opal, been swamped.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No worry, Bo—I'll grab some flagging tape and mark it now, so the crew doesn't miss it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal—you're a lifesaver. I owe you one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? The Smiths are collecting broken gadgets and furniture—I heard Faye's bringing a lamp!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's perfect timing! I was just thinking about the repair drive this Saturday—those wrenches will come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wrenches! The Smiths will be thrilled—they mentioned needing tools for the bigger fixer-upper projects.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait—are we talking about the same thing? I mean the broken pipe in the basement, not a community event. Did you see that damage or not?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I think we're mixing things up—the repair drive is this Saturday to fix up the community center, not a specific pipe. Have you heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you haven't seen that basement pipe at all? I really need to know if it's worth us chipping in for a proper repair.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! You've heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center, right? We're getting the whole neighborhood together to fix things up—everyone's invited!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Yes, yes, I remember now—Saturday at the community center. I think I wrote it down somewhere, but I'm glad you reminded me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! Don't forget to bring any tools you can spare—we're collecting them to help with the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, could you help me sort these donated tools? I want to make sure we have everything ready for when folks start arriving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, let's get them organized. I think we'll need a separate pile for screws and bolts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great idea, Uli, and let's group the screwdrivers by size too—makes it easier for people to grab what they need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Eli, have you decided what you're bringing to the repair drive this Saturday? I'm trying to get a headcount on larger items.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got a broken fence post and a chair with a wobbly leg. Planning to drop them off first thing, before the 9 o'clock start.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, those sound manageable—I’ll note you down for early drop-off. I’ve got my lamp coming too, so we’ll have a good mix of items.
